workspaceSummary: Listing Review & Approval Workspace consolidates the complete listing package for human review. It does not create eBay drafts, publish listings, upload images or mutate data. It marks the internal Listing module as ready for review, not ready for external eBay execution.

architecturePolicy.productsRule: Products decide what the product is.
architecturePolicy.listingRule: Listing decides how the product sells on eBay.
architecturePolicy.benchmarkRule: Benchmark decides what is working in the market.
architecturePolicy.gatesRule: Gates decide whether the listing can advance.
architecturePolicy.operatingPrinciple: Benchmark can suggest. Listing can adapt. Products must confirm. Gates must approve.
architecturePolicy.visualSourceOfTruthRule: Luna Portex catalog image is visual source of truth.
architecturePolicy.humanApprovalRule: Human approval is required before any future external action.

selectedProductReview.source: Complete Listing Package Builder selected product reference
selectedProductReview.summary: Review selected product identity and confirm Products remains source of truth.

generatedListingContentReview.summary: Review title, description, item specifics and keyword plan before any final content approval.

catalogImagePackageReview.source: Luna Portex catalog image package policy
catalogImagePackageReview.summary: Confirm catalog source, rights, image QA and exact product fidelity before real image execution.

secondaryImagePromptsReview.source: Complete Listing Package Builder secondary image prompts
secondaryImagePromptsReview.summary: Review the six planned prompts before any real image generation.

draftPayloadDryRunReview.summary: Review local payload preview while submission to eBay remains blocked.

missingFactsReview.source: Mapped product facts and package blockers
missingFactsReview.summary: Missing or unconfirmed facts must be confirmed in Products before advancement.

blockedFieldsReview.summary: Category, price, shipping, returns, images, compliance and external connection remain blocked.

readinessGatesReview.source: Complete Listing Package Builder readiness gates
readinessGatesReview.summary: Internal review is allowed while eBay submission, draft creation and publication stay blocked.

complianceReview.summary: Compliance and VeRO review must be completed before any future external action.

finalApprovalReview.summary: Approval is displayed as required but is not persisted in this loop.

readinessSummary.listingInternalReadinessLabel: Internal listing package ready for human review

finalModuleDefinition.nextPhase: eBay Sandbox / Real Image Execution / External Integration

nextRecommendedPhase.phase: PHASE 2 — Real Image Execution + eBay Sandbox Integration
nextRecommendedPhase.firstRecommendedStep: Generate actual listing images from Luna Portex catalog source for one selected product, then validate image QA before any eBay API work.
constraints: Use Luna Portex catalog image as visual source of truth.
